product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp customer-communication platform for business sales, support, and retention teams, combining a shared inbox, automation, campaigns, and CRM integrations.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 15 employees.

hq_location.notes: Public directories describe Rasayel as remote/distributed and differ on the headquarters label; this is the explicit headquarters location reported by the cited company profile.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog is a marketing/product and WhatsApp-business learning center; no two engineering build or architecture posts were identified.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No dedicated AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role was listed. The accessible Senior Software Engineer listing was marked 6+ months old, and the company page reported zero jobs posted.

model_provider.notes: The public material describes AI and LLM-token usage but does not identify the underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed security policy names security controls and infrastructure but does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification.

last_funding.notes: The October 2026 Series A is reported by funding databases; some older databases still show only the 2022 seed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported Series A was in October 2026, within the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The identified sales-executive posting explicitly says applications are no longer accepted; no current SDR, BDR, or account-executive posting was found.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest readable launch-type changelog entry is dated April 28, 2026, before the May 9-November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page was checked in full; it lists the CEO and COO/co-founders but gives no indication that a C-level or VP-level person joined during the window, and no departure is announced.
